scope: Published independent 2D airfoil solver, not the experimental 3D core
reference: Exact symmetric Joukowski map; e=0.08, R=1.08, unit chord. Exact circulation and independent dense pressure integration. No viscous/experimental validation.
sampling: Panel Cp at midpoint parameter compared to exact curved profile midpoint; 2% chord edge exclusion only for Cp RMS. All panels retained in force/moment integration and profile files.
